name: Like A Butterfly
shortDescription: Bold and beautiful. A striking butterfly graphic tee full of color and personality.
description: Like A Butterfly is one of CALLESIL's most expressive pieces. A vibrant, detailed butterfly graphic that brings color and life to every outfit. Designed for those who wear their personality proudly — this tee is anything but ordinary.

name: Stay Fresh Stay Bloom
shortDescription: Fresh florals and summer energy. A colorful graphic tee made for bright days.
description: Stay Fresh Stay Bloom captures the spirit of summer in a single tee. Bright floral graphics, warm tones and a feel-good energy that goes with everything. Made for the days when you want your outfit to match your mood.

name: Imperfect
shortDescription: Embrace the imperfect. A playful, original graphic tee with a message.
description: Imperfect is a celebration of originality. A bold, expressive graphic that says what it means — wear it as a reminder that standing out is always the right choice. One of CALLESIL's most personal designs.

name: Money Maker
shortDescription: Bold, confident and unapologetic. A graphic tee that makes a statement.
description: Money Maker is for those who own the room. A bold, confident graphic design that brings attitude and color to your wardrobe. One of CALLESIL's most eye-catching pieces — wear it and mean it.

name: Wild West Disco
shortDescription: Where the wild west meets disco fever. A fun, colorful graphic tee full of character.
description: Wild West Disco is pure CALLESIL energy. A playful collision of cowboy culture and disco vibes — bold, colorful and impossible to ignore. This is the tee for the days when you want to bring the party with you.

name: Salty Hair
shortDescription: Sun, salt and good vibes. A breezy ocean-inspired graphic tee for summer days.
description: Salty Hair is for the beach lovers, the ocean dreamers and the sun chasers. A laid-back, colorful graphic tee that captures the feeling of salt in the air and sand between your toes. Summer in a tee.

name: Haunted Season
shortDescription: Spooky, playful and original. A Halloween graphic tee made for the season.
description: Haunted Season is CALLESIL's love letter to Halloween. A spooky, playful graphic design packed with personality — made for those who take their Halloween seriously. Bold, original and impossible to miss.

name: Sailor Dreams
shortDescription: Nautical vibes and ocean dreams. A colorful, artistic graphic tee for the sea lovers.
description: Sailor Dreams takes you straight to the coast. A nautical-inspired graphic tee with a colorful, artistic twist — bold imagery, ocean tones and a design that feels like a postcard from the sea. For the dreamers and the wanderers.
